item.title: Amazon Scans and Destroys Books for AI Training
item.description: A tracked shipment exposed an Amazon operation that buys, disassembles and scans physical books to obtain AI-training material.

item.title: Cursor Launches Origin, Its GitHub Alternative
item.description: Cursor is expanding from AI coding into repository infrastructure, bringing code, agents and deployment integrations under one roof.

item.title: Groq Raises $350M to Expand Its AI Cloud
item.description: Groq’s new financing backs its evolution from an inference-chip company into a vertically integrated provider of AI computing services.

item.title: Higgsfield Raises $400M at a $5.4B Valuation
item.description: The generative-media company has secured a major round to scale its video and image platform amid intensifying AIGC competition.

item.title: Meshy Details Its Alignment Method for Image-to-3D
item.description: Meshy’s new technical report explains how its latest system more faithfully transfers a reference image into usable 3D geometry.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 17
item.description: · Arena added task categories and cost-to-completion data to its Agent Leaderboard, enabling performance-and-price comparisons.（Arena on X） · AI workflow startup Relay is shutting down, with its staff joining Google’s Chrome team.（TechCrunch） · Former SpaceX engineers are building an automated factory designed to manufacture steel components with robotics.（Ars Technica） · Dreamina Seedance 2.5 reached first place for video editing on Arena’s crowdsourced Video Arena leaderboard.（Arena on X） · Replit introduced black-box penetration tests that probe deployed apps externally, with Replit Agent able to address detected vulnerabilities.（Replit on X） · Nvidia’s Nemotron 3.5 Lightning became available through Amazon SageMaker JumpStart for streamlined model deployment.（AWS Machine Learning Blog） · Cartesia’s Sonic 3.6 took first place in both Provider Voice and Controlled Voice on Artificial Analysis’s Speech Arena.（Artificial Analysis on X） · Cartesia’s Sonic 3.6 generated 136.1 characters per second and cost $49 per million characters in Artificial Analysis testing.（Artificial Analysis on X） · AWS published a reference workflow enabling OpenClaw agents to conduct transactions through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore’s payment capabilities.（AWS Machine Learning Blog） · LlamaIndex said ExtractBench only credits extracted fields when both the value and its source citation are correct.（LlamaIndex on X） · OpenAI said retained reasoning and compaction raised GPT-5.6 Sol’s ARC-AGI-3 score from 13.3% to 38.3% while using roughly sixfold fewer output tokens.（OpenAI Developers on X） · ElevenLabs launched a Claude-compatible MCP integration for securely managing voice and conversational agents without running a separate server.（ElevenLabs on X） · Voice-input startup Wispr raised $280 million at a $2 billion valuation as it expands beyond dictation.（TechCrunch） · Palona raised $20 million to develop AI automation products for physical retail and other brick-and-mortar businesses.（SiliconANGLE）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 17
item.description: · Oracle outlined an enterprise AI strategy embedding agents in databases, maximizing GPU utilization and eliminating multicloud data-transfer fees.（InfoQ 中文） · Anthropic explained how invisible SynthID Text watermarks could identify Claude-generated writing without visibly altering its output.（The Verge） · Dropbox integrated MCP with Dash to connect enterprise context, security design and code-review workflows for AI-assisted development.（InfoQ 中文） · HarmonyOS 7 added controls allowing supported on-device AI phones to display information about their locally installed model versions.（IT之家） · MediaTek announced day-zero support for Alibaba’s Qwen 3.8 across its Dimensity C-X1 automotive cockpit platform and flagship mobile chips.（IT之家） · Huawei shared communication optimizations designed to improve Pangu model training and inference performance on its Ascend hardware platform.（InfoQ 中文） · Netflix detailed its internal large-model serving platform, which combines Triton and vLLM to operate production inference workloads.（InfoQ 中文） · Lovart added Seedance 2.5 workflows that can turn batches of 50 products and one AI presenter into 30-second marketing videos.（Lovart on X） · DeepSeek released a developer preview of DeepSeek Harness, an MIT-licensed agent runtime whose tools and components operate as plugins.（MarkTechPost） · Two humanoid robots completed an entire first-to-11 table-tennis match, demonstrating sustained perception, movement and rally coordination.（量子位） · MIT Technology Review examined the emotional consequences for children when Moxie, an AI companion robot, becomes permanently unavailable.（MIT Technology Review） · Fields Medalist Timothy Gowers said AI’s most productive role in difficult mathematics currently resembles an argumentative collaborator challenging proposed reasoning.（量子位） · Google announced Gemini and Pixel partnerships with football clubs, offering supporters AI-assisted ways to engage with teams and matches.（Google） · Researchers introduced a world model capable of real-time generation combining 24-fps visuals with synchronized 48-kHz stereo audio.（量子位）
